question_text: A Provincial Capitol purchased 48 desktop computers and 32 printers for its field offices. Express the ratio of computers to printers in simplest form.

blueprint_id: Ratio and Proportion — simplifying ratios into lowest terms
deconstruct_text:
Imagine the Provincial Capitol’s IT upgrade: 48 brand-new desktops sa barangay hall at 32 printers para sa bawat kagawad. Ratio ng computers to printers? 48:32.

Para ma-simplify, hanapin ang Greatest Common Divisor — yung 'pinakamalaking common factor'. Factors ng 48: 1,2,3,4,6,8,12,16,24,48. Sa 32: 1,2,4,8,16,32. Ang common na pinakamalaki: 16.

Divide pareho: 48÷16=3, 32÷16=2 → 3:2. Walang common factor pa ang 3 at 2, kaya fully simplified na. Tandaan: order matters, computers always first!
